verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a money-movement API like Stripe Treasury, but the evidence documents only single-object operations: individual OutboundPayments, single fund movements, and Transaction ledger entries. No batch or bulk endpoint, bulk payout, or multi-item action is documented. The CLI and MCP probes show tooling exists but say nothing about bulk operations, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
